_description: One row per case. Records the final resolution of each process episode. Normalized from the company-level case for cleaner calibration queries. This table is the primary input for P(deal) calibration, premium distribution, time-to-resolution, and failure drawdown analysis.

outcome_date.description: Date outcome became publicly known. For deals: deal announcement 8-K date. For wind-down: wind-down announcement date. For bankruptcy: Chapter 7/11 filing date.

initial_signal_type.description: Signal type at first_observation_date. Redundant with cases.csv for direct outcome query without join.

initial_sequence_type.description: Sequence type at the time of first_observation_date. For outcome analysis: does this sequence type correlate with better P(deal)?

mcap_band.description: Market cap bucket at first_observation_date. Used to segment P(deal) tables.

deal_value_M.description: Total deal equity value in USD millions. Null for non-deal outcomes.

deal_price_per_share.description: Per-share consideration. Null for non-deal or non-cash consideration.

acquirer.description: Acquirer name. Null for non-deal outcomes.

acquirer_type.description: Category of acquirer. Used to identify acquirer-type patterns in outcomes.

deal_premium_pct.description: Premium to 30-day pre-announcement average price. NOT to price_at_signal. See anti-look-ahead rules.

price_30d_after_signal.description: Closing price 30 calendar days after first_observation_date. Not adjusted for deal outcome.

max_drawdown_pct_after_signal.description: Maximum percentage decline from price_at_signal to trough within 365 days. Critical for failure-case downside assumptions. Negative value (e.g., -0.42 = -42% drawdown).

time_to_resolution_days.description: Calendar days from first_observation_date to outcome_date. For ONGOING cases, null.

failure_reason.description: For non-deal outcomes: what observable factor drove the failure. Grounded in contemporaneous evidence only. No hindsight. See anti-look-ahead rules.

failure_mode.description: Standardized failure mode classification for false-positive cases. Enables pattern analysis: which failure modes are most common by signal type?

contemporaneous_source_url.description: EDGAR URL of the filing that announced the outcome (deal announcement 8-K, wind-down 8-K, bankruptcy filing). Must be primary source.

rofr_scope.description: For ROFR_ROFN cases: scope of the rights that were present. Used to calibrate ROFR scope detection in scanner.

hotspot_area.description: Therapeutic area. Used to test whether hotspot exposure correlates with better P(deal) independently of process signals.

verified.description: True if all outcome fields confirmed against primary sources (EDGAR + press release + Bloomberg).

_calibration_tables.p_deal_by_signal_type: GROUP BY initial_signal_type, COUNT(outcome_type = ACQUIRED) / COUNT(*) WHERE verified=TRUE
_calibration_tables.p_deal_by_sequence_type: GROUP BY initial_sequence_type, COUNT(outcome_type = ACQUIRED) / COUNT(*) WHERE verified=TRUE
_calibration_tables.p_deal_by_mcap_band: GROUP BY mcap_band, initial_signal_type, COUNT(outcome_type = ACQUIRED) / COUNT(*) WHERE verified=TRUE
_calibration_tables.median_premium: PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) of deal_premium_pct WHERE outcome_type=ACQUIRED AND verified=TRUE
_calibration_tables.median_time_to_deal: PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) of time_to_resolution_days WHERE outcome_type=ACQUIRED AND verified=TRUE
_calibration_tables.failure_drawdown: PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) of max_drawdown_pct_after_signal WHERE outcome_type IN (DEAL_FAILED, REVIEW_ABANDONED, BANKRUPT) AND verified=TRUE
_calibration_tables.failure_mode_frequency: GROUP BY failure_mode, COUNT(*) WHERE outcome_type != ACQUIRED AND verified=TRUE
